facts-found.fact: Services build every handoff policy with kind 'unresolved' today; policy ids are keyed HMAC ids or unresolved-{answerId}.
Through the ordinary HTTP path model facts are extracted_unverified, so items are missing or unverified. Known items need an independent reviewer batch, which is disabled by default.
Item reason 'as_of_required' marks a dated fact set aside because no asOf was given.
not_permitted means explicitly not permitted by a non-model source (a documented restriction), not an authorization failure.
Authorization failures (consent revoked or expired, deleted document, superseded document) surface from readForCatalogue as coded errors; revocation erases the answer (404).

block4-household-reasoning.risk: security-sensitive (household read path, consent) and data-sensitive. No migration. No new dependency.

gaps.gap: No existing route accepts several sources; the new POST route is added instead of widening the GET catalogue route.

Known-fact HTTP journeys need reviewed facts; the service adapter takes an injectable catalogue builder so tests can supply handoffs built from buildDecisionCatalogue with an accepted human_review batch, while the real catalogue service is used for the unverified and revocation journeys.
